Who I Am

Designing with Purpose

I'm a UI/UX designer and a graduate of Delta University For Science And Technology, Faculty of Artificial Intelligence, with a background in technology and a passion for creating intuitive and user-centered digital experiences. I enjoy transforming complex ideas into simple, clean, and visually engaging interfaces.

I design user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile applications using tools like Figma and AI tools. My process focuses on user research, user flows, information architecture, wireframes, and high-fidelity prototypes to create products that are both functional and visually appealing.

I focus on understanding the problem before starting the design. I pay close attention to user behavior, structure, and small details to create designs that are not only visually appealing, but also clear, intuitive, and easy to use. My goal is to help clients turn their ideas into digital products that provide a smooth and meaningful user experience.

Featured Work

Selected Projects

01
Mobile App · Healthcare

CareMate

A healthcare app combining medication delivery and home nursing services in one intuitive platform.

SituationPeople often face difficulties accessing reliable medication delivery and home nursing services in one place, especially when caring for family members with chronic conditions.
TaskDesign a user-friendly healthcare mobile app that allows users to order medicines, upload prescriptions, book home nursing services, and chat directly with a pharmacist for quick consultation and support.
ActionConducted user research, surveys, and competitive analysis, then designed the information architecture, user flows, and UI for the CareMate app to ensure a simple and trustworthy user experience.
ResultDeveloped a clear and intuitive app concept that helps users manage medications and access home healthcare services from one convenient platform.
View Case Study →
02
Mobile App · Herbal Wellness

Attark

A digital herbal store where users discover safe natural remedies, search by symptoms, and connect with specialists.

SituationMany people prefer natural herbal remedies but feel confused about which herbs are suitable for their symptoms and how to use them safely.
TaskDesign a simple mobile app that helps users easily discover the right herbs and understand how to use them correctly.
ActionI designed ATTARAK, an herbal marketplace app where users can search by symptoms (like headache) to get suitable herbs and herbal mix packages, view detailed information for each item including benefits, usage instructions, and warnings, upload prescriptions, and chat with a specialist for guidance.
ResultThe app makes herbal remedies easier to explore and trust by combining clear information, expert communication, and a simple purchasing experience in one platform.
